mapper.select:
select t.id, t.product_id as productId, t.ip, t.public_ip as publicIp, t.ip_address as ipAddress, t.user_id as userId, t.email, t.status, t.use_time as useTime, t.create_time as createTime, t.update_time as updateTime, t2.customer_name as nickname from sys_network_product_ip t left join sys_customer t2 on t.user_id = t2.id
and t.status = #{param.status}
and t.product_id = #{param.productId}
and t.email like concat ('%',#{param.email},'%')
and t.ip like concat ('%',#{param.ip},'%')
and t.public_ip like concat ('%',#{param.publicIp},'%')
and t2.customer_name like concat ('%',#{param.customerName},'%')
order by t.use_time, t.status desc, t.id asc
